as_told.title: 2004 Nimitz Tic Tac picked up by a new FLIR system

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 2004 a new FLIR system, a camera that sees heat, made by the defense company Raytheon, had just been installed with a US Navy aircraft carrier group off San Diego before it recorded an unexplained object. According to the story, Raytheon then kept its distance from what its camera had picked up, which Michels raises in a debate with a skeptic.
